description: This file defines the 'BuzzShare' entity class in a PHP project using Doctrine ORM. It models a social media post or share with properties like post, employee, likes, comments, type, text, and timestamps, along with methods to access and modify these properties.

classes.name: BuzzShare
classes.description: Entity class representing a social media share/post, with properties for identifiers, related post and employee, metrics like likes and comments, type, content, and timestamps.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the share.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the share.

methods.name: getPost
methods.description: Returns the BuzzPost associated with this share.

methods.name: setPost
methods.description: Associates a BuzzPost with this share.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee who created the share.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee who created the share.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of share/post (post or share).

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the text content of the share.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text content of the share.

methods.name: getCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp in UTC.

methods.name: setCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp to current UTC time.

methods.name: getUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the last update timestamp in UTC.

methods.name: setUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the last update timestamp to current UTC time.
